public_rationale: The sources establish relevant rendering limitations and childhood competence in an ellipsis task. They do not independently test the post's complete claim about June 2022 DALL-E Mini. General compositionality results and selected pictures cannot establish construction-specific comprehension failures.
limitations: The searches do not establish that no suitable evaluation exists.
The checkpoint and intended child comparison remain unspecified.
All retained evidence is contextual rather than decisive.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: DALL-E Mini does not seem to grasp ellipsis, comparatives or pronouns, which children learn easily.

statement.excerpt: Ellipsis, comparative and pronouns are routine, everyday components of language, readily acquired by children. DALLE-mini does not seem to grasp them.
statement.document_title: Three ideas from linguistics that everyone in AI should know

from_speaker: DALLE-mini does not seem to grasp them
our_interpretation: Read 'does not seem to grasp' as unreliable handling of the named constructions, not an assertion that every generated image fails.
The examples concern comparisons of quantities, omitted predicates and reflexive pronouns.
Use June 2022 through the publication date as the contemporaneous observation period because no testing dates or model checkpoint are supplied.
Read 'readily acquired' as ordinary childhood acquisition, not perfect comprehension at every age.
Image-generation failures alone do not establish which linguistic operation failed.
criteria.support_condition: Independent, representative tests of the contemporaneous DALL-E Mini checkpoint show recurring failures on all three constructions, with suitable controls, while acquisition studies establish ordinary childhood competence in comparable constructions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable controlled tests establish reliable handling of the named constructions by the contemporaneous checkpoint, or acquisition evidence clearly defeats the stated childhood contrast. Isolated successes or developmental errors are insufficient.
